messages:
maya: Just finished a 30m call with Crestline ops. Summary: they see inconsistent reranking in multi-turn workflows and want a per-tenant fallback policy so they can force a cheaper model when latency spikes. They gave a short repro and asked for a timeline.

samir: thanks — can you paste the repro here? is this happening only on Dedicated or hosted as well?

maya: paste from call: 
```
User: 'Summarize last 3 messages and rank suggested next steps'
System: initial run on rdx-3b -> OK
Follow-up turn: same prompt, different ranking order returned, confidence dropped from 0.92 -> 0.53
Observed on both hosted and dedicated for this customer (they're hybrid).
```

anita: that confidence swing looks like a model-variant fallback or quantization mismatch. Could also be tokenization differences if they concatenate context differently.

leo: quick Q — do they use prefix cache or per-request KV caching? that changes continuity across turns.

maya: they use our standard session tokens with prefix caching enabled. They wanted a control to say: if latency > 300ms, route to rdx-1b with deterministic rerank settings (i.e., no sampling).

samir: sounds like two asks: (1) per-tenant routing policy by latency threshold + forced-model-variant, (2) an option to enforce deterministic decoding for reranking endpoints. both are product-ish. P2? P1?

anita: assign P1 to deterministic rerank toggle — that will reduce customer visible flakiness. routing policy can be P2 but with a clear config UX.

leo: from infra side, latency-based routing needs metric hooks and a per-tenant policy store. we can prototype with a feature-flagged rollout for Crestline.

maya: i told the customer we'd follow up by EOW with a proposed plan. I'll open a ticket and include the repro + call notes.

samir: please create a GH issue and link to the tenant support case. tag me + product. template: 
- steps to reproduce
- expected vs observed
- suggested mitigation (deterministic rerank toggle)
- short-term workaround (pin model to rdx-1b)

maya: created draft: https://notion.redwood/company/cs/crestline-rerank-1765439998 (posted in thread). tagging @cs-bot to create tracking ticket. :thumbsup:

cs-bot: Ticket CS-4127 created and assigned to samir. Due date set to 2024-11-08.

anita: i'll scope effort for deterministic rerank toggle today and share estimate. if small we can do a canary with Crestline next week.

samir: agreed — prioritize deterministic toggle. i'll schedule a short triage with eng + infra. maya — please send the raw logs from the call (snippets) into the ticket.

maya: will do. thanks everyone.

anita: note for product board: this request blends reliability + cost controls. good candidate for a roadmap slot under "serve controls".

leo: adding to backlog: infra/latency-routing-proto. linking to CS-4127.

maya: closing loop with Crestline: i'll follow up after we have the canary plan. :wave:
